fn-route-03.back: Heavy pack, brush, dark, rests, bad weather (60% plus Tip).

fn-route-04.back: A gentle downhill of about 5 percent, about 6 km an hour. Flat is 5.

fn-route-09.front: Do BC clocks go back on 1 November 2026?
fn-route-09.back: No. BC stays on daylight time (UTC minus 7) all year from March 2026 (95%). November light comes an hour later on the clock.
